edits.new: least(100,greatest(0,100-case when completion_ratio<timeline_progress_ratio-0.2 then 30 else 0 end-case when not(completion_ratio<timeline_progress_ratio-0.2) and not(completion_ratio>timeline_progress_ratio+0.1) and abs(coalesce(committed_points-prev_committed_points,0))>committed_points*0.1 then 20 else 0 end-case when abs(remaining-ideal)>committed_points*0.3 then 25 else 0 end+case when completion_ratio>timeline_progress_ratio+0.1 then 10 else 0 end+case when completion_ratio/nullif(timeline_progress_ratio,0)>1.1 then 15 else 0 end))::integer sprint_health_score

coalesce(
            (select
                case
                    when fh.field_value ~ '^[0-9]+\.?[0-9]*$' then fh.field_value::numeric
                    when fh.field_value ~ '^.*([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*).*$' then
                        regexp_extract(fh.field_value, '([0-9]+\.?[0-9]*)', 1)::numeric
                    else null
                end
             from staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history fh
             join staging.stg_jira__field f on fh.field_id = f.field_id
             where fh.issue_id = i.issue_id
               and f.field_name ilike '%story%point%'
               and fh.is_active = true
             order by fh.updated_at desc
             limit 1),
            1  -- Default story point value
        ) points
